audit.proof_assessment: v4 FINDINGS are not authority over these bytes. Both cited MEDIUMs are already closed in the supplied text: completed+proposalEnvelopeHash unconditionally requires the unique interruptHash, decisionHash, and decisionValue accept-proposal; apply eligibility repeats that bind; selectionSource slash requires slashInvocationHash for the whole segment and accept-proposal re-checks command/registry liveness. Treat v4 as a stale pre-remediation reading, not an open defect.
residual_risks: Apply eligibility is written as an envelope predicate, not an exhaustive ban; compare-arm, outputArtifactHash, partialOutputHash, and skill-receipt outputs are not named as never-apply-eligible.
HumanInterruptV1.invocationId and ProposalEnvelopeV1.skillInvocationReceiptHash remain optional, so a receipt-only checker may not see the slash binding even though the completion CAS must.
ReceiptBundleManifestV1 is an unauthenticated hash list and cannot be treated as a second authority gate.
SkillInvocationReceiptV1 terminal combinations are not closed with the same non-completed proposal ban as RouteSegmentReceiptV1.
A kill switch during interrupted blocks accept-proposal but is not itself a cancel trigger, so the reservation can remain held until interrupt expiry.
